questions.question: NestJS architecture dựa trên những khái niệm cốt lõi nào?

options.B: Modules (tổ chức), Controllers (routes), Services/Providers (business logic), Decorators (@Controller, @Get, @Injectable), Dependency Injection

questions.explanation: NestJS architecture inspired by Angular: Module: @Module({ imports, controllers, providers, exports }) — đơn vị tổ chức code. Controller: @Controller('users') với @Get(), @Post() decorators — handle HTTP requests. Provider/Service: @Injectable() chứa business logic — injected vào controllers qua DI. DI Container: tự manage lifecycle của services. Decorators: @Param(), @Body(), @Query(), @Headers(), @Req(), @Res(). Pipes: transformation & validation. Guards: authorization. Interceptors: logging, caching. Exception Filters: error handling.

questions.question: NestJS Guards là gì và khác gì với Middleware?

options.B: Guards: có access đến ExecutionContext (request context), chạy sau middleware, trả về boolean/Observable để allow/deny, dùng @UseGuards(). Middleware không biết về route handler
options.D: Middleware không thể thực hiện authentication

questions.explanation: @Injectable() class AuthGuard implements CanActivate { canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean { const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest(); const token = request.headers.authorization; return this.authService.validateToken(token); } }. Dùng: @UseGuards(AuthGuard). Global: app.useGlobalGuards(new AuthGuard()). Middleware: function middleware(req, res, next) — không có ExecutionContext, không biết về handler/class. Guards chạy sau middleware, trước interceptors và pipes. Role guard: @SetMetadata('roles', ['admin']) + Reflector để read metadata.

questions.question: NestJS Pipes là gì và khi nào dùng?

options.A: Pipes chỉ dùng để format strings
options.B: Pipes: transform và validate data trong request pipeline; built-in: ValidationPipe, ParseIntPipe, ParseUUIDPipe; custom pipe implement PipeTransform interface
options.D: Pipes chỉ dùng cho query params

questions.explanation: Pipes chạy trước controller handler, sau route matching. ValidationPipe: app.useGlobalPipes(new ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true, transform: true })). Class-validator: @IsEmail(), @IsString(), @MinLength(8) trên DTO. ParseIntPipe: @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number — tự chuyển string → number, throw 400 nếu không valid. ParseUUIDPipe: validate UUID format. Custom pipe: class CapitalizePipe implements PipeTransform { transform(value: string) { return value.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + value.slice(1); } }.

questions.question: NestJS Exception Filters hoạt động thế nào?

options.B: @Catch(ExceptionClass) class filter implements ExceptionFilter{ catch(exception, host) } — intercept exceptions, format error response; built-in: HttpException, NotFoundException, ForbiddenException
options.D: Exception filters chỉ bắt được HTTP errors

questions.explanation: Built-in exceptions: throw new NotFoundException('User not found'), BadRequestException, UnauthorizedException, ForbiddenException, ConflictException, InternalServerErrorException. Custom filter: @Catch(HttpException) class HttpExceptionFilter implements ExceptionFilter { catch(exception: HttpException, host: ArgumentsHost) { const ctx = host.switchToHttp(); const response = ctx.getResponse(); const status = exception.getStatus(); response.status(status).json({ statusCode: status, message: exception.message, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }); } }. Global: app.useGlobalFilters(new HttpExceptionFilter()).

questions.question: NestJS Interceptors dùng để làm gì?

options.A: Interceptors chỉ dùng để log requests
options.B: @Injectable() class với NestInterceptor, intercept(context, next) — có thể transform response, add logging, implement caching, timeout; dùng rxjs operators

questions.explanation: @Injectable() class LoggingInterceptor implements NestInterceptor { intercept(context: ExecutionContext, next: CallHandler): Observable<any> { const now = Date.now(); return next.handle().pipe(tap(() => console.log(`${Date.now() - now}ms`))); } }. Patterns: Response transformation: map(data => ({ data, statusCode: 200 })). Timeout: timeout(5000). Cache: tap(data => this.cacheService.set(key, data)). Error logging. Response envelope pattern. Order: Middleware → Guards → Interceptors → Pipes → Handler → Interceptors (after) → Exception Filters.

questions.question: NestJS Modules — cách tổ chức và @Global module?

options.A: Tất cả services đều tự động global
options.B: Module đóng gói controllers, providers; exports để chia sẻ providers; imports để dùng providers từ modules khác; @Global() để accessible everywhere không cần import

questions.explanation: Module pattern: @Module({ imports: [TypeOrmModule.forFeature([User]), AuthModule], controllers: [UsersController], providers: [UsersService, UsersRepository], exports: [UsersService] }). Importing: để use UsersService trong OrdersModule → imports: [UsersModule]. @Global(): @Global() @Module({ providers: [ConfigService], exports: [ConfigService] }) — ConfigService accessible everywhere mà không cần import module. AppModule (root) imports tất cả feature modules. Dynamic modules: forRoot() / forRootAsync() pattern cho configurable modules (TypeOrmModule.forRoot(config)).

questions.question: NestJS với TypeORM — repository pattern và entity relationships?

options.B: @Entity, @Column, @OneToMany/@ManyToOne, @ManyToMany; Repository<Entity> cho CRUD; TypeOrmModule.forFeature([Entity]); migrations

questions.explanation: @Entity() class User { @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid') id: string; @Column({ unique: true }) email: string; @OneToMany(() => Post, post => post.author) posts: Post[]; }. @Entity() class Post { @ManyToOne(() => User, user => user.posts) @JoinColumn() author: User; }. Repository: @InjectRepository(User) private userRepo: Repository<User>. findOne({ where: { id }, relations: ['posts'] }). Query builder: this.userRepo.createQueryBuilder('user').leftJoinAndSelect('user.posts', 'post').where('user.id = :id', { id }).getOne(). TypeOrmModule.forFeature([User, Post]) trong module.

questions.question: NestJS CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) pattern?

options.A: CQRS không khả thi trong NestJS
options.B: @nestjs/cqrs: Commands (write) vs Queries (read) separate handlers, EventBus cho domain events, saga cho complex workflows
options.C: CQRS chỉ cần khi dùng microservices
options.D: CQRS làm phức tạp code không cần thiết

questions.explanation: @nestjs/cqrs: Command: class CreateUserCommand { constructor(public readonly dto: CreateUserDto) {} }. Handler: @CommandHandler(CreateUserCommand) class CreateUserHandler implements ICommandHandler<CreateUserCommand> { async execute(command) { return this.userService.create(command.dto); } }. Query: class GetUserQuery extends IQuery {}. Dispatch: this.commandBus.execute(new CreateUserCommand(dto)). Event: this.eventBus.publish(new UserCreatedEvent(user)). EventHandler: @EventsHandler(UserCreatedEvent). Saga: @Saga() userSaga = (events$) => events$.pipe(ofType(UserCreatedEvent), map(event => new SendWelcomeEmailCommand(event.user.email))). Dùng khi: complex domain logic, audit trail needed.

questions.question: NestJS Microservices — transport layers nào được support?

options.B: TCP, Redis, NATS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, GRPC — qua @nestjs/microservices; MessagePattern và EventPattern decorators; ClientProxy để send messages

questions.explanation: Microservice setup: createMicroservice({ transport: Transport.REDIS, options: { host: 'localhost', port: 6379 } }). Controller: @MessagePattern({ cmd: 'get_user' }) async getUser(@Payload() data: { id: string }) { return this.usersService.findOne(data.id); }. Client: @Client({ transport: Transport.REDIS }) client: ClientProxy. this.client.send({ cmd: 'get_user' }, { id: userId }). Event: @EventPattern('user_created'). Kafka: Transport.KAFKA với Kafka config. gRPC: protobuf definitions. Hybrid app: HTTP + Microservice. Request-response vs event-based messaging.

questions.question: NestJS với GraphQL — Code First vs Schema First?

options.B: Code First: TypeScript classes với decorators (@ObjectType, @Field, @Resolver) → auto-generate schema. Schema First: .graphql files → generate types. @nestjs/graphql + Apollo

questions.explanation: Code First: @ObjectType() class User { @Field() id: string; @Field() email: string; }. @Resolver(() => User) class UserResolver { @Query(() => [User]) async users() { return this.userService.findAll(); } @Mutation(() => User) async createUser(@Args('input') input: CreateUserInput) { return this.userService.create(input); } @ResolveField(() => [Post]) async posts(@Parent() user: User) { return this.postService.findByUser(user.id); } }. DataLoader: @nestjs/dataloader để tránh N+1. Subscription: @Subscription() → pubSub.asyncIterator. Apollo Federation cho micro-graphql.

questions.question: NestJS Testing — Unit tests và E2E tests?

options.B: Test.createTestingModule() với mock providers, jest.fn(); E2E: supertest với INestApplication; @nestjs/testing module
options.D: NestJS chỉ dùng được với Mocha

questions.explanation: Unit test: const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ providers: [UsersService, { provide: getRepositoryToken(User), useValue: mockUserRepository }] }).compile(); const service = module.get<UsersService>(UsersService); it('should return user', async () => { mockUserRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockUser); expect(await service.findOne('1')).toEqual(mockUser); }). E2E test: const app = moduleRef.createNestApplication(); await app.init(); return request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/users').expect(200).expect(response => expect(response.body).toHaveLength(2)). Mock: jest.spyOn(service, 'findAll').mockResolvedValue([]).

questions.question: NestJS ConfigModule và secrets management?

options.B: ConfigModule.forRoot() load .env, ConfigService.get() typed access, validation với Joi/Zod, @nestjs/config cho complex config
options.D: Config không thể validate trong NestJS

questions.explanation: ConfigModule.forRoot({ isGlobal: true, validationSchema: Joi.object({ NODE_ENV: Joi.string().valid('development','production').required(), DATABASE_URL: Joi.string().required(), JWT_SECRET: Joi.string().min(32).required() }), envFilePath: '.env' }). Injection: constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {} this.configService.get<string>('DATABASE_URL'). Typed config: @ConfigType register functions. Nested config: ConfigModule.forRoot({ load: [databaseConfig, jwtConfig] }). Factory: registerAs('database', () => ({ host: process.env.DB_HOST, port: +process.env.DB_PORT })). class DatabaseConfig { @IsString() host: string; @IsInt() port: number; }.

questions.question: Implement NestJS JWT authentication với Passport?

options.B: @nestjs/passport + @nestjs/jwt; JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy); JwtAuthGuard; sign token trong AuthService

questions.explanation: @Injectable() class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) { constructor(configService: ConfigService) { super({ jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(), ignoreExpiration: false, secretOrKey: configService.get('JWT_SECRET') }); } async validate(payload: { sub: string; email: string }) { return { userId: payload.sub, email: payload.email }; } }. AuthService: async login(user: User) { return { access_token: this.jwtService.sign({ sub: user.id, email: user.email }) }; }. Guard: @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard). JwtModule.registerAsync({ useFactory: (config) => ({ secret: config.get('JWT_SECRET'), signOptions: { expiresIn: '15m' } }), inject: [ConfigService] }).

questions.question: NestJS với Bull queue cho background jobs?

options.A: NestJS không hỗ trợ background jobs
options.B: @nestjs/bull: @BullModule.forRoot() + @BullModule.registerQueue('email'); @Processor('email') với @Process(); @InjectQueue để add jobs
options.C: Chỉ dùng cron jobs cho background tasks

questions.explanation: BullModule.forRoot({ redis: { host: 'localhost', port: 6379 } }). BullModule.registerQueue({ name: 'email' }). @Processor('email') class EmailProcessor { @Process('send-welcome') async sendWelcome(job: Job<{ userId: string }>) { const { userId } = job.data; await this.emailService.sendWelcomeEmail(userId); } @OnQueueFailed() async handleFailed(job: Job, error: Error) { this.logger.error(`Job ${job.id} failed: ${error.message}`); } }. Add job: @InjectQueue('email') private emailQueue: Queue; await this.emailQueue.add('send-welcome', { userId: user.id }, { attempts: 3, backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 1000 } }).

questions.question: Implement NestJS WebSocket gateway?

options.B: @WebSocketGateway() class với @SubscribeMessage() handlers, @WebSocketServer() server, emit events từ services; có thể dùng rooms và namespaces

questions.explanation: @WebSocketGateway({ namespace: '/chat', cors: { origin: '*' } }) class ChatGateway implements OnGatewayConnection, OnGatewayDisconnect { @WebSocketServer() server: Server; handleConnection(client: Socket) { client.join(client.handshake.query.room as string); } @SubscribeMessage('message') handleMessage(client: Socket, payload: { room: string; content: string }): void { this.server.to(payload.room).emit('message', { sender: client.id, content: payload.content }); } handleDisconnect(client: Socket) { console.log(`Client disconnected: ${client.id}`); } }. Guards: @UseGuards(WsAuthGuard). Emit from service: this.server.emit('notification', data).

questions.question: NestJS rate limiting và throttling?

options.A: NestJS không có built-in rate limiting
options.B: @nestjs/throttler: ThrottlerModule.forRoot(), @UseGuards(ThrottlerGuard), @Throttle() override per route, Redis store cho distributed
options.C: Rate limiting chỉ cần ở Nginx

questions.explanation: ThrottlerModule.forRootAsync({ imports: [ConfigModule], useFactory: (config) => ([{ ttl: config.get('THROTTLE_TTL', 60000), limit: config.get('THROTTLE_LIMIT', 100) }]), inject: [ConfigService] }). Global: app.useGlobalGuards(new ThrottlerGuard()). Or: providers: [{ provide: APP_GUARD, useClass: ThrottlerGuard }]. Per route: @Throttle({ default: { limit: 5, ttl: 60000 } }) @Post('login'). Skip: @SkipThrottle(). Redis store: ThrottlerStorageRedisService → share limits across pods. Custom key: override generateKey() in ThrottlerGuard.

questions.question: NestJS OpenAPI documentation với Swagger?

options.B: @nestjs/swagger: SwaggerModule.createDocument() + SwaggerModule.setup(); @ApiProperty, @ApiOperation, @ApiResponse, @ApiBearerAuth decorators
options.C: Swagger chỉ dùng được thủ công

questions.explanation: Setup: const config = new DocumentBuilder().setTitle('API').setVersion('1.0').addBearerAuth().build(); const document = SwaggerModule.createDocument(app, config); SwaggerModule.setup('api', app, document). DTO: @ApiProperty({ description: 'User email', example: 'user@example.com' }) @IsEmail() email: string. Controller: @ApiTags('Users') @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get all users' }) @ApiResponse({ status: 200, type: [UserDto] }) @ApiResponse({ status: 401, description: 'Unauthorized' }) @ApiBearerAuth() @Get(). CLI plugin (nest-cli.json): { 'compilerOptions': { 'plugins': ['@nestjs/swagger'] } } — auto-generate from TypeScript types.

questions.question: NestJS custom decorators và metadata?

options.B: createParamDecorator() cho param decorators; SetMetadata() + Reflector cho metadata; composing decorators với applyDecorators()

questions.explanation: Param decorator: export const CurrentUser = createParamDecorator((data: string, ctx: ExecutionContext) => { const request = ctx.switchToHttp().getRequest(); const user = request.user; return data ? user?.[data] : user; }). Dùng: @Get('me') getMe(@CurrentUser() user: User). Metadata + Guard: export const Roles = (...roles: string[]) => SetMetadata('roles', roles). Guard: const requiredRoles = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<string[]>('roles', [context.getHandler(), context.getClass()]). Composed decorator: export const Auth = (...roles: string[]) => applyDecorators(Roles(...roles), UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard), ApiBearerAuth()).

questions.question: Circular dependency trong NestJS DI — nguyên nhân và fix?

options.A: Circular dependency không thể xảy ra trong NestJS
options.B: Module A import Module B và Module B import Module A → circular. Fix: forwardRef(() => ServiceB), lazy injection, hoặc tách shared logic vào Module C
options.D: Restart app là đủ để fix

questions.explanation: Error: Circular dependency detected. Causes: ServiceA injects ServiceB, ServiceB injects ServiceA. Fix 1: forwardRef: constructor(@Inject(forwardRef(() => ServiceB)) private serviceB: ServiceB). Module level: imports: [forwardRef(() => ModuleB)]. Fix 2: Extract shared logic vào SharedModule/CommonService không có circular dep. Fix 3: Use events (EventEmitter2) thay direct injection. Fix 4: Lazy injection với ModuleRef: this.moduleRef.resolve(ServiceB). Best practice: nếu cần forwardRef nhiều → sign của bad architecture, refactor thành shared module.

questions.question: NestJS ValidationPipe không validate nested objects — cách fix?

options.B: Dùng @ValidateNested() + @Type(() => NestedDto) từ class-transformer; enableImplicitConversion: true cho type coercion; whitelist:true để strip unknown

questions.explanation: Nested validation: class CreateOrderDto { @ValidateNested({ each: true }) @Type(() => OrderItemDto) items: OrderItemDto[]; }. class OrderItemDto { @IsUUID() productId: string; @IsInt() @Min(1) quantity: number; }. ValidationPipe config: app.useGlobalPipes(new ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, // strip unknown properties forbidNonWhitelisted: true, // throw on unknown transform: true, // transform payloads to DTO instances transformOptions: { enableImplicitConversion: true } // auto convert string '123' → number 123 })). Array validation: @IsArray() @ValidateNested({ each: true }) @Type(() => ItemDto) items: ItemDto[].

questions.question: NestJS app slow startup trong Docker — nguyên nhân?

options.B: Lazy loading modules (LazyModuleLoader), tree-shaking, tránh heavy imports trong startup, TypeORM migrations chậm, connection warmup
options.D: NestJS không phù hợp với Docker

questions.explanation: Slow startup causes: (1) TypeORM: synchronize: true (scan + alter tables on start) → disable in production, dùng migrations. (2) Heavy module initialization: ThrottlerModule, PassportModule. (3) Eager loading tất cả modules. Fix: (1) LazyModuleLoader: lazy load feature modules. (2) TypeORM: runMigrations in separate step trước app start. (3) Disable synchronize production. (4) Connection pool pre-warm: await dataSource.initialize(). (5) SWC compiler thay tsc: @swc/core (10x faster compilation). (6) ts-jest với isolatedModules: true cho tests. Measure: time docker run app.

questions.question: NestJS unhandled exception in async Provider — cách debug?

options.A: NestJS tự handle tất cả exceptions
options.B: Exceptions trong providers không được bắt bởi exception filters; cần try/catch trong providers; onApplicationBootstrap hoặc APP_INTERCEPTOR để log
options.C: Exceptions trong providers crash app silently
options.D: Chỉ exception filters trong controllers cần thiết

questions.explanation: Exception filters chỉ bắt exceptions từ controller layer. Errors trong services/providers không qua exception filters. Patterns: (1) Try/catch trong service methods. (2) Global error handler: process.on('unhandledRejection') để log. (3) Custom ExceptionFilter với APP_FILTER token. (4) onModuleInit() trong providers phải handle own errors. (5) Interceptor với catchError(err => throwError(() => new HttpException(...))). (6) APP_INTERCEPTOR global để wrap all responses: providers: [{ provide: APP_INTERCEPTOR, useClass: ErrorInterceptor }]. Debug: NestJS logger level: all → verbose stack traces.

questions.question: NestJS TypeORM query performance — N+1 problem?

options.B: N+1: select N users → N selects posts. Fix: eager loading (relations), query builder với leftJoinAndSelect, DataLoader pattern, @nestjs/dataloader
options.C: N+1 không xảy ra với TypeORM

questions.explanation: N+1 với TypeORM: const users = await userRepo.find(); users.map(u => postRepo.findBy({ userId: u.id })) → 1 + N queries. Fix 1: Eager relations: findOne({ where: { id }, relations: { posts: true } }) → 1 query với JOIN. Fix 2: QueryBuilder: createQueryBuilder('user').leftJoinAndSelect('user.posts', 'post').getMany(). Fix 3: DataLoader (cho GraphQL): new DataLoader(async (userIds) => { const posts = await postRepo.findBy({ userId: In(userIds) }); return userIds.map(id => posts.filter(p => p.userId === id)); }). Logging slow queries: TypeORM logging: ['query', 'slow'] với maxQueryExecutionTime: 1000.

questions.question: NestJS test fails với 'Cannot find module' — causes?

options.A: Tests không thể fail với import errors
options.B: Module path aliases (tsconfig paths) không được jest config; absolute vs relative imports; moduleNameMapper trong jest.config.js

questions.explanation: Fix: jest.config.js: moduleNameMapper: { '^@/(.*)$': '<rootDir>/src/$1', '^@common/(.*)$': '<rootDir>/src/common/$1' }. Or ts-jest with tsconfig.json paths. Common issues: (1) Missing @types/jest. (2) tsconfig.json baseUrl không được jest biết → dùng pathsToModuleNameMapper(compilerOptions.paths). (3) Missing mock for external module: jest.mock('ioredis'). (4) Missing .env for tests: dotenv.config({ path: '.env.test' }). (5) Circular dep in tests. Jest setup: 'jest': { 'moduleFileExtensions': ['js','json','ts'], 'transform': { '.*\.(ts)$': 'ts-jest' }, 'testEnvironment': 'node' }.

questions.question: NestJS microservices với Kafka — event-driven architecture?

options.B: Transport.KAFKA với KafkaOptions config, @MessagePattern + @EventPattern, consumer groups, schema registry, dead letter queue, retry logic
options.D: Mỗi microservice cần NestJS riêng biệt

questions.explanation: Kafka microservice: ClientsModule.register([{ name: 'ORDERS_SERVICE', transport: Transport.KAFKA, options: { client: { brokers: ['kafka:9092'] }, consumer: { groupId: 'orders-consumer' } } }]). Producer: this.ordersClient.emit('order.created', { orderId, userId }). Consumer: @EventPattern('order.created') async handleOrderCreated(@Payload() data: OrderCreatedEvent, @Ctx() context: KafkaContext) { const { offset, partition } = context.getMessage(); await this.processOrder(data); }. Dead letter queue: configure in consumer group. Retry: { retries: 3, restartOnFailure: async (err) => true }. Schema Registry: Avro/Protobuf schemas.

questions.question: NestJS performance optimization cho high-traffic API?

options.B: SWC compiler, Fastify adapter, response compression, Redis caching, connection pooling, PM2 cluster, lazy loading, query optimization

questions.explanation: NestJS performance: (1) Fastify adapter: const app = await NestFactory.create<NestFastifyApplication>(AppModule, new FastifyAdapter()) → 2-3x faster than Express. (2) SWC compiler: { 'compilerOptions': { 'builder': 'swc' } } in nest-cli.json → 20x faster compile. (3) Redis cache interceptor: cache responses với TTL. (4) TypeORM connection pool: extra: { max: 20, min: 5 }. (5) Lazy module loading: LazyModuleLoader. (6) Enable compression: app.use(compression()). (7) PM2: ecosystem.config.js với cluster mode. (8) Health check + Kubernetes HPA. (9) Avoid synchronize in production. (10) Index DB columns.

questions.question: NestJS Enterprise patterns — multi-tenancy?

options.B: Request-scoped providers với REQUEST injection token, TenantInterceptor set tenant context, tenant-specific DB connections với TypeORM
options.C: Chỉ cần separate databases là đủ

questions.explanation: Multi-tenancy patterns: (1) Request-scoped tenant service: @Injectable({ scope: Scope.REQUEST }) class TenantService { constructor(@Inject(REQUEST) private req: Request) { this.tenantId = req.headers['x-tenant-id']; } }. (2) Interceptor: set tenantId từ subdomain/header. (3) TypeORM per-tenant: dynamic connection management với ConnectionManager. (4) Row-level security: tenant_id WHERE clause trong mọi query. (5) Tenant middleware + AsyncLocalStorage để propagate tenant context cross-service calls. (6) NestJS REQUEST scope vs TRANSIENT scope. Schema-per-tenant vs shared schema vs database-per-tenant trade-offs.

questions.question: NestJS deployment với Docker Compose cho local development?

options.A: Docker Compose không cần thiết với NestJS
options.B: docker-compose.yml với app, postgres, redis, kafka services; volumes cho hot reload; environment variables; health depends_on; watch mode
options.D: NestJS không support hot reload trong Docker

questions.explanation: docker-compose.yml: services: app: build: . ports: ['3000:3000'] volumes: ['./src:/app/src'] environment: - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@postgres:5432/db depends_on: postgres: { condition: service_healthy } redis: { condition: service_started } command: npm run start:dev. postgres: image: postgres:16-alpine healthcheck: { test: pg_isready, interval: 5s }. redis: image: redis:alpine. Dockerfile dev: FROM node:20-alpine; COPY package*.json ./; RUN npm install; COPY . .; CMD ['npm', 'run', 'start:dev']. Docker watch (Compose v2.22): watch: { action: sync, path: ./src, target: /app/src }.

questions.question: NestJS observability — structured logging, tracing, metrics?

options.B: Custom Logger với Pino, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, Prometheus metrics với @willsoto/nestjs-prometheus, correlation IDs, error tracking
options.D: Monitoring chỉ cần tại infrastructure level

questions.explanation: Custom Logger: class AppLogger extends Logger { log(message, context) { pino.info({ context, message, correlationId: cls.get('correlationId') }); } }. app.useLogger(new AppLogger()). Correlation ID: middleware → AsyncLocalStorage.run({ correlationId: uuid() }, next). OpenTelemetry: import '@opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node' → auto-instrument HTTP, DB. Prometheus: @InjectMetric('http_requests_total') counter.inc({ method, route, status }). Endpoint: /metrics → Prometheus scrape → Grafana. Sentry: SentryInterceptor + Sentry.captureException(). Health: TerminusModule với TypeOrmHealthIndicator, RedisHealthIndicator.

questions.question: NestJS security hardening cho production API?

options.B: Helmet, CORS whitelist, rate limiting, CSRF protection, SQL injection prevention với TypeORM, secrets management, dependency audit, penetration testing
options.D: Security chỉ cần ở load balancer

questions.explanation: Security checklist: (1) Helmet: app.use(helmet()) — CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options. (2) CORS: { origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(','), credentials: true }. (3) Rate limiting: @nestjs/throttler với Redis store. (4) CSRF: csurf middleware cho session-based auth. (5) TypeORM: parameterized queries prevent SQL injection. Never raw queries với string concatenation. (6) Secrets: HashiCorp Vault hoặc AWS Secrets Manager. (7) Input: ValidationPipe whitelist + forbidNonWhitelisted.
